name: lottery_n_draws
description: Number of ball draws in the 3-2-1 lottery; remaining picks by reverse record. USER DEFAULT. Evidence (NBA.com, Tankathon, Hoops Rumors) says ALL 16 picks are drawn, i.e. 16 - see G2 report sensitivity.

name: lottery_redraw_blocked
description: A restricted team drawn at a blocked slot is redrawn (equivalent to excluding it from that slot's candidates).

name: lottery_restrictions_follow_pick
description: Top-5/#1 restrictions follow the original team's pick when traded (toggle). Consistent with NBA.com 'regardless of whether the pick was traded' and ESPN UTA->MEM example.

name: lottery_7v8_loser_keeps_ball_if_makes_playoffs
description: 7-vs-8 play-in loser keeps its 1 ball even if it wins the 8-seed game.

name: lottery_floor_pick_three_worst
description: Three worst records cannot fall below this pick.

name: tpg_min_games_pct
description: Turnover-leader qualifier; defaults to the same 58/82 rule as PTS/REB/AST. UNCONFIRMED with the book (NBA.com has no TPG qualifier).

name: leader_min_games_pct
description: NBA.com PTS/REB/AST/STL/BLK qualifier (58 of 82), with total-based exception.

name: cup_nonqualifier_games_each
description: Each of 22 Cup non-advancing teams plays 2 regular-season games on Dec 6-10 (22 games total).

name: cup_nonqualifier_pairing
value: random within conference per sim, 1 home 1 away; cross-conference only if counts odd
description: USER SPEC. NOTE: NBA.com says 2 of the 22 non-qualifier games are cross-conference; set cup_nonqualifier_cross_conf_games to reproduce.

name: cup_qf_loser_games
description: The 4 quarterfinal losers play 1 game each pairing within conference (2 games).

name: cup_semifinal_site
value: higher seed's home arena (NBA.com); user spec said neutral site
description: Semis count as regular-season games; final does not. DISCREPANCY flagged. Toggle cup_semis_neutral (default 0).

name: cup_semis_neutral
description: 1 = neutral-site semis (user spec); 0 = higher seed hosts (NBA.com).

name: tank_incentive_toggle_teams
description: Teams whose 2027 pick terms are not fully reconciled; tank incentive is a manual toggle, not modeled.
